# Urban Splatter

> > Urban Splatter is a celebrity real estate and lifestyle publication covering luxury homes, net worth profiles, and architectural design across America.

Founded in 2012 by Justin and Dave, Urban Splatter publishes in-depth celebrity home tours, net worth analyses, and design features. The site combines property journalism with celebrity culture coverage, featuring exclusive home tours and financial profiles of entertainment and sports personalities.

## Key Topics

- Celebrity Homes
- Luxury Real Estate
- Celebrity Net Worth
- Home Design
- Architecture
- Property Tours
- Celebrity Profiles
- Construction
- Lifestyle
- Real Estate Markets
- Sustainable Design
- Estate Features
- Phoenix Residences
- California Properties
- Sports & Entertainment Figures

- [Alex Honnold House: The Las Vegas Retreat](https://www.urbansplatter.com/2026/03/alex-honnold-house-the-las-vegas-retreat): Alex Honnold's Las Vegas luxury home featuring sustainable design and features.
- [Steve Yzerman House: The Bloomfield Hills Estate](https://www.urbansplatter.com/2026/03/steve-yzerman-house-the-bloomfield-hills-estate): Steve Yzerman's Bloomfield Hills mansion tour showcasing luxury architecture.
- [George Marks House: The Grass Valley Retreat](https://www.urbansplatter.com/2026/03/george-marks-house-the-grass-valley-retreat): George Marks' Grass Valley retreat featuring unique architecture and natural setting.
